inference_config.entrypoint: mineru.cli.common.do_parse (the function the `mineru` CLI itself calls, invoked in-process so the model singleton stays warm across pages)

license.notes: Founder decision 2026-09-03 (receipts/registry-updates/license-mineru_pipeline.json): status verified, research benchmark execution allowed. LICENSE.md at the pinned runtime_revision is Apache License 2.0 plus additional terms, not bare Apache-2.0: (1) a commercial-licence threshold - a separate commercial licence from the MinerU Team is required once you and your affiliates, on a consolidated basis, exceed 100 million MAU or USD 20 million in total monthly revenue; (2) an online-service attribution obligation - a service built on MinerU must clearly and prominently state that it uses MinerU, in the product/service interface or in public documentation; (3) automatic termination of the licence on breach of either term. text_sha256 above is the sha256 of LICENSE.md fetched read-only from source_url at the pinned revision.

notes: MinerU 3.4 moved the pipeline OCR stage to PP-OCRv6. The adapter calls mineru.cli.common.do_parse in-process rather than spawning the CLI per page, because the CLI reloads every pipeline model on each invocation while do_parse reuses MinerU's ModelSingleton; it is the same entrypoint the CLI itself calls. The pipeline backend has no single checkpoint - MinerU downloads seven sub-trees of PDF-Extract-Kit-1.0 - so the repository revision is the pin and largest_file is the largest of those seven, not the largest file in the repository. method=ocr, not auto, because every arena input is a rendered PNG with no text layer to detect. The licence id is not a standard SPDX identifier and commercial use is unresolved; that is a founder decision. Resolution provenance and every open question live in provenance.json next to this file. D16 (2026-09-03 second integration pass): the two repositories this runtime pins are different things and runtime.json now says so in its own fields. model_repo / model_revision = opendatalab/PDF-Extract-Kit-1.0 @ ed6b654c018d742e65a17671e379c5e6ecc87ec9 is the MODEL WEIGHTS repository on Hugging Face (the seven sub-trees the pipeline backend downloads). runtime_repository / runtime_revision = opendatalab/MinerU @ fbb1257a555a3fde78ae5aaaa931e3b3f8fb2883 is the RUNTIME CODE repository on GitHub (tag mineru-3.4.5-released), which is what the earlier model_registry.json row named. The registry copies both from here. Both were re-verified read-only on 2026-09-03: huggingface.co/api/models/opendatalab/PDF-Extract-Kit-1.0/revision/ed6b654c returned that sha, and api.github.com/repos/opendatalab/MinerU/commits/fbb1257a returned that commit. prompt_kind is "none" (D34): the pipeline backend takes no prompt, adapter.py refuses a non-empty prompt_text, and prompt_registry/mineru_pipeline_no_prompt.txt is the empty file. Framework-floor audit (2026-09-03, after the GLM-OCR canary died on an unrecognised model_type): the required framework floor, what the pinned base image actually ships, the action taken and the evidence URLs are recorded in provenance.json under framework_floor_audit. bootstrap.sh asserts the pinned framework versions and that the framework recognises this checkpoint's architecture before anything starts.
